name: Aktion National Airport
before:
The airport for Lefkada and Preveza, on the Aktion peninsula in western Greece. It is listed under both names, Aktion and Preveza, which catches people out when they are searching for flights.

It opened in 1968 and remains a shared civil and military field, used by the Hellenic Air Force Command and by NATO alongside the holiday traffic.

Since autumn 2016 it has been run by the Fraport and Copelouzos joint venture, which took on Aktion and thirteen other Greek regional airports under a forty year concession signed in December 2015.
after:
The airport for Lefkada and Preveza, at Aktion. It is listed under both names, Aktion and Preveza, which catches people out when they are searching for flights.

Since April 2017 it has been run by Fraport Greece, which took on Aktion and thirteen other Greek regional airports under a forty year concession signed in December 2015.

claims.claim: run by Fraport Greece since April 2017; Aktion and thirteen other regional airports; a forty year concession signed in December 2015
claims.inAfter: Since April 2017 it has been run by Fraport Greece, which took on Aktion and thirteen other Greek regional airports under a forty year concession signed in December 2015.
claims.note: Was 'Since autumn 2016 it has been run by the Fraport and Copelouzos joint venture'. Fraport AG: the concession agreements were signed on 14 December 2015 and run 40 years from the transfer of operations on 11 April 2017, for 14 airports including Aktion. Fraport Greece describes itself as established in 2017, a joint venture of Fraport AG, the Copelouzos Group and Marguerite. Wikipedia still has the older plan of autumn 2016.
